annotations.title: Follow new federal grants to state and local governments

description:
New federal project grants and cooperative agreements to state and local governments
    (USAspending assistance awards), largest first: the government, the program, the purpose, the
    dollars obligated, and where that government posts its bids (its entry in SpendQuery's
    bid-portal directory: portal, open-bids list, vendor registration) when the name matches a
    listed state, county or city. Use it for "which cities near me just won federal money for
    X": the government usually buys the work itself, later, on its own portal. A grant is a
    sign, not a solicitation; say so, and send the user to the portal to look for the bid.

days.description: Grants made in the last 30, 90, 180 or 365 days of loaded data (default 90).
days.title: Days

q.description: Words in the grant's purpose, program or recipient, e.g. "runway" or "water".
q.title: Q
